title: Coated wire dish rack
description: a plastic-coated, steel wire, drying rack for dishes and mugs
reference_excerpt: The product in question is a plastic-coated, steel wire drying rack specifically designed for household use, intended for drying dishes and mugs. The Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) classification falls under subheading 7323.99.9060, which covers "table, kitchen or other household articles and parts thereof, other, other, not coated or plated with precious metal, other, other, other." This classification is appropriate because the drying rack is a household article made primarily of steel and is not plated with precious metals. The rate of duty for this classification is 3.4 percent ad valorem, which aligns with the characteristics and intended use of the product as described.

classification.rationale: Heading 7323 names household articles of iron or steel, and a plastic-coated steel wire dish rack fits it under GRI 1. Ruling G85054 (in force) put a plastic-covered steel wire dish drainer in 7323.99.9060, but that suffix no longer exists in the current schedule. I chose the current residual line 7323.99.90.80. The choice between .30 and .80 rests on treating the rack as not food-contact tableware.
